original_card.question: Can a changed G20 helper path or independent-target split improve the complete BIT moment without losing its physical endpoint?
methods: Construct and independently check one source-bound instance of the stated first experiment.
Seek an exact counterexample or target-specific complete-budget obstruction to that same proposed change.
original_card.acceptance_gate: A full boundary contract and paid profile; unchanged scalar counts alone are insufficient. A scoped local result may be retained without a complete supplier. Expanding it into further construction rounds requires the family-level budget and obligation gate in research-family-status.md; an optimistic passing relaxation alone is not acceptance.

first_step.inspect: Read revision 8, the selected review and live exact-source handoffs. Then follow this card's bounded first_experiment.
first_step.scope: Source-bound orientation only, not a supplier replay or theorem proof.

original_card.first_experiment: First read #5679/#5708 and their audits as pending component proposals. Choose one uncovered helper group/cut on an exact word; compare arbitrary-input native action, targets, owned storage, both orientations and full signed bill. Stop if the gain is only a scalar count or repaid by lost targets. Do not rerun the frozen #5609 common-frame domain without changing its hypothesis.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Judge the actual current supplier contract and complete signed target/paid bill; frozen-profile ceilings require an applicability proof.
allowed_variations: One exact source head, helper/cut region or quantified proposition and changed hypothesis; check live handoffs first. Different seeds are not different scopes.
scope_change_triggers: Changing source head, helper/cut domain, operation alphabet or caller boundary without recording the new scope.
Treating an archived proposal or local numerical pass as complete supplier admission.

existing_checks.scope: Selected PR5599: complete helper-subspace construction and independent caller replay; five framework assumptions remain.
existing_checks.remaining: The next experiment must identify uncovered source-specific work. Successor archive intake does not transfer this admission.

actual_scope: One released G20 column: initialized joint threshold/comparison closure, 19 main-state bits, at most 3248 row-history values and literal forward/copy/return.
scope_change_reason: The card asks for a BIT moment mechanism. This scoped component instead changes the initialized carry-producer state representation; no paid moment or supplier improvement is claimed.
bottleneck_link: Side result on the missing physical carry-producer implementation. Smaller logical state can inform a caller, but table lookup and history arithmetic must be priced before any supplier claim.
stop_rule: Stop at the first exact local improvement. Do not extend to other columns or optimize the table.
evidence: PROOF.md, generated RESULT.json, every-edge integer-prefix oracle, complete inverse census, modular packet/dirty-output/return checks in normal and optimized Python.
author: Nick Petalas
ai_assistance: Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.
